admin.title: Badges, levels and perks
admin.intro: Automatic evaluation runs nightly — changes here apply from the next run.

manualAward.heading: Award a badge manually
manualAward.intro: For badges like the annual honour that automatic evaluation never grants.

levels.heading: Levels
levels.note: Lowering a threshold promotes members immediately; raising one never demotes anyone who already reached it.

perks.heading: Perks
perks.canHostWarning: Enabling this stops some members from proposing sessions until they reach this level — off by default, since the platform's whole premise is that you don't need to be an expert.
